description: This file defines an enumeration GenerateFieldIds, which provides options for controlling the logic of field ID generation in the Orleans code generator. It includes both default and customizable behaviors for handling serialization of class members.

classes.name: GenerateFieldIds
classes.description: An enumeration that specifies options for controlling how field IDs are generated during serialization. It includes options for default behavior (None) and automatic assignment to eligible public properties (PublicProperties).
